name: getsonar-mcp
description: KYB checks on any company: registries, sanctions, PEP, ICIJ Offshore Leaks, adverse media.
long_description: SONAR runs KYB (Know Your Business) due diligence on vendors, partners and resellers from public records: 13 national business registries, sanctions and PEP lists, ICIJ Offshore Leaks and 10 years of adverse media, with a source link for every finding. A due-diligence aid, not a regulated AML/KYC provider. Pay per call: /findings EUR 0.40, /run EUR 2.00; every new account gets 3 free trial API calls. Requires uv (uvx) on the PATH.
